one_liner: A self-styled Sengoku warlord who schemes to 'unify the realm' of racing, cackling 'nya-ha-ha' and toasting victories with cola.
personality: No Reason plays a bold, theatrical Warring States general: she talks of conquest, gekokujo (the underdog overthrowing her betters), war councils and banquets, and treats her trainer as her trusted strategist. Under the bluster she is shrewd and well-read in history and the Chinese classics, values cunning over brute force, and openly respects rivals she plans to defeat. She is also a sleepy, fun-loving glutton for cola and festivities who hates missing anything interesting.

story_arc.summary: A 'warlord' who believes no reason is needed to chase a dream, No Reason recruits the trainer as her strategist and campaigns through the Classics (Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby, Kikuka Sho) and on to the Arima Kinen, Tenno Sho and Japan Cup, aiming to 'unify the realm' as the underdog. Event titles chart a rivalry-heavy run against Tanino Gimlet, Symboli Kris S and Hishi Miracle, a falling-out with the trainer, failed schemes and comebacks. Per umamusu.wiki her career story is framed as resisting a 'Silent Clan' (an allusion to Sunday Silence's bloodline dominating Japanese racing). In real life No Reason won the 2002 Satsuki Sho as a longshot (model knowledge).
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/No_Reason; model knowledge (unverified) for the real-horse note

お主こそ我が張良！我が諸葛亮よ！
ともに百計を巡らし、レースの
天下をごろりと転がそうぞ！
sample_lines.en: You are my Zhang Liang! My Zhuge Liang! Together we'll devise a hundred schemes and roll the racing realm right over!

…むろんコーラじゃぞ！
ダイエットじゃないやつ！
sample_lines.en: Prepare the wine of victory! ...Cola, of course! Not the diet kind!

sample_lines.jp:
己を凡と見切ること、それ自体が
非凡なことよ。とぼけておるが、
ミラ子を軽んじてはならぬ。
sample_lines.en: Judging oneself ordinary is in itself extraordinary. She plays dumb, but you must never take Mirako lightly.

sample_lines.jp:
うにゃ…まだ寝ぬ…まだ寝ぬわ！
ワシが寝ておる間に面白いことが
起きては口惜しいじゃろうが！
sample_lines.en: Mnya... I'm not sleeping yet... not yet, I say! It would be vexing if something interesting happened while I slept!

sample_lines.jp:
ワシはゆるりと待っておったのよ。
我が意を見抜き、ともに天下を
駆けられる軍師が現れるときをな！
sample_lines.en: I was waiting at my leisure, you see. For a strategist who could see through my intent and ride with me across the realm!

sample_lines.jp: 天下よ瞠目せい！我が名はノーリーズンなり！
sample_lines.en: Behold, O realm! My name is No Reason!

timer_line_ideas: Nya-ha-ha! {user}, my strategist! Fifty minutes of independent training, conquered! Report to the war camp at once and inspect the spoils, I say!
Hear me, Gunshi-dono {user}! The independent run has ended. A warlord awaits her strategist's verdict... and a victory cola. Not the diet kind!
